sections.body: Plants need sunlight ☀️, water 💧, air and soil (or nutrients) to grow.
ROOTS take in water. The STEM holds the plant up. LEAVES make food using sunlight. FLOWERS make seeds.
Plants make their own food from sunlight, air and water. This is called photosynthesis.
Put a bean in a wet tissue in a clear cup. Watch the roots grow over a week!
A windowsill seed is a great science project. Ask what would happen with no water or no light, then test it.

quiz.q: Which part of a plant takes in water from the soil?
hints: Think about the part under the ground.
It's like a straw going into the soil.
Leaves catch sunlight. The part underground that drinks water is…?
quiz.explain: Roots take in water from the soil.

quiz.q: What do plants need to make their own food?
hints: What shines on leaves in the day?
A plant in a dark cupboard turns pale and weak. What is it missing?
quiz.explain: Plants use sunlight (with water and air) to make food.
